newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's PHIBOR rates jump in all maturities.
newsitem.headline: Manila's PHIBOR rates jump in all maturities.

text.p: The Philippine interbank offered rates (PHIBOR) jumped in all maturities on Friday in reaction to the 2.25 percentage-point increase in the Central Bank's overnight borrowing rate, traders said.
The Central Bank raised its key rate to 15 percent to fend off a possible fallout of Thailand's problems. This prompted banks to adjust their swap rates.
Short-term rates, however, were higher than the longer term since banks remained cautious on the short-term outlook of interest rates.
"The market doesn't know when the 15 percent will last. We're looking at Tuesday or Wednesday as the start of the correction in rates," a dealer said.
